name: eu-legal-notice
title: EU Company Legal Info Extractor (SIREN, P.IVA, CIF, KvK, VAT)
description: Give it a list of company websites and get back the legal entity name, registration number (SIREN/SIRET, Partita IVA, CIF/NIF, KvK, KBO, NIP/KRS, UK company number, HRB), VAT ID, share capital and email from the site's legal-notice page. Pay only when data is found.
